jobs.title: Manager, Customer Strategy & Operations
jobs.why: Excellent healthcare-operations fit combining practice onboarding, client partnership, operational analysis, scalable playbooks, growth enablement, and cross-functional work with product, billing, clinical, and engineering. Kevin’s ABA operations, intake/process work, training, and systems-project background map very well.
jobs.gap: The role values 3–5+ years in client-facing consulting, strategy/operations, or startup business operations plus financial modeling comfort. Kevin should emphasize practice-facing operations, Excel/reporting, process design, and keep SQL positioned as foundational/working knowledge.

jobs.title: Practice Operations Manager II
jobs.why: Strong healthcare practice-operations match focused on efficient clinical workflows, staff supervision, patient experience, compliance, and administrative operations. Kevin’s ABA intake, case coordination, training, and process-improvement work transfers directly.
jobs.gap: Columbia may favor candidates with deeper formal medical-practice management and direct supervisory scope. Kevin should foreground healthcare operations ownership, staff training, workflow management, and measurable service improvements.

jobs.title: Partnerships Operations Manager
jobs.why: Very strong healthcare-tech operations role spanning partner onboarding, stakeholder management, cross-functional delivery, operational systems, metrics reporting, and durable process design. Kevin’s systems, implementation, client operations, and healthcare background are highly relevant.
jobs.gap: The role asks for 5–7 years across partnerships, business operations, program management, or customer success in a high-growth environment. Kevin should emphasize end-to-end project ownership and external stakeholder communication.

jobs.title: Manager, Business Operations
jobs.why: Direct fit for project management, business analysis, process mapping, onboarding, change management, automation, and cross-functional delivery. Kevin’s workflow redesign, systems implementation, documentation, and stakeholder coordination align closely.
jobs.gap: Publishing is outside Kevin’s core domain, and the role requests 5–7+ years. He should sell the transferable operations-and-systems story and quantify implementation/process improvements.

jobs.title: Business Operations Manager
jobs.why: Strong systems-minded generalist role involving new tools and processes, GTM enablement, quantitative analysis, finance/operations projects, and scaling a high-growth company. Kevin’s Salesforce, Power Apps, automation, reporting, and cross-functional project work fit the operating model.
jobs.gap: Modal wants 5+ years in business functions plus comfort with technical products, coding, and deeper quantitative analysis. Kevin should emphasize systems fluency without overstating coding or SQL depth.

jobs.title: Sr. Training Operations Manager
jobs.why: Excellent bridge between healthcare and Kevin’s training/operations experience. The role centers on training operations, learning systems, governance, scalable execution, and commercial-learning infrastructure, which aligns with his BT training, onboarding, documentation, and systems work.
jobs.gap: This is a senior global training-operations role and may expect deeper enterprise learning-platform governance. Kevin should emphasize training program ownership, operational standardization, and system/process implementation.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Sales Agency Operations
jobs.why: Healthcare growth-operations role with strong overlap in partner operations, process improvement, scalable workflows, reporting, and cross-functional execution. Kevin’s healthcare context plus CRM/automation and growth-operations background make this a credible stretch.
jobs.gap: Senior-manager scope and Medicare Advantage distribution experience are likely the biggest gaps. Kevin should frame CRM/process work and partner-facing operations strongly while treating the payer-distribution domain as learnable.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Strategy & Operations
jobs.why: Good match for strategy execution, process improvement, cross-functional coordination, and operational planning. Kevin’s project-management, reporting, workflow redesign, and stakeholder-management experience translate well despite the industry change.
jobs.gap: The senior-manager title may require broader strategic leadership and nonprofit/community-development familiarity. Kevin should use quantified examples of cross-functional delivery and process ownership.

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.why: Strong healthcare-adjacent operations role involving program operations, leadership, call-center/service operations, and CMS-related work. Kevin’s healthcare operations, intake workflows, staff support, training, and process-management background are relevant.
jobs.gap: The role may favor direct CMS program or government-contractor experience. The salary floor is below $100K, though the posted band extends to $132K, so Kevin should target an offer above his minimum.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Support Operations
jobs.why: Strong operations-systems stretch role centered on scaling support operations, improving processes, using data, and coordinating across teams. Kevin’s workflow automation, CRM/systems work, reporting, training, and operational problem solving provide a relevant foundation.
jobs.gap: Rippling is likely to expect substantial direct support-operations leadership at scale. Kevin should position team training, process ownership, systems improvement, and measurable operational outcomes as the core story.
